name: auth-4
title: Full-Height Split Sign-In
description: Full-height split-screen sign-in with email, password, remember-me, and Google or GitHub buttons beside a dark marketing panel on a grid backdrop.

standards.purpose: Get a returning user back into the product with one clear, low-friction path.
useWhen: The user already has an account and needs to authenticate.
doNotUseWhen: The user is creating an account (use a sign-up form).

rules.check: Every input carries a visible label or aria-label; a placeholder alone does not label a field.
Credential inputs declare autocomplete values so password managers work.
Validation errors are announced to assistive tech and tied to their field, not shown by color alone.
The card has one primary submit action; social providers stay secondary.
